🔥 kharos | Luau
🎯 Primary Use Case: A real-time strategy game playable in a web browser, focusing on base building, resource management, logistics, and combat with procedural generation and unique code-generated visuals.
✨ Key Features: • Procedural map generation with multiple biomes and terrain effects • Asset-less pixel art generated by shaders and code • Dynamic weather and day/night cycles
📖 Summary: Kharos is a multiplayer browser-based RTS game built with Luau and Rust, featuring procedural map generation, complex economy and logistics systems, and tactical combat. It emphasizes a unique 'pixel art without assets' approach where graphics and sound are synthesized by code.
